svg.title: Projects
svg.desc: Demian (Open source): Deterministic 2D game platform; Hanna Music Player (Open source): Laravel music application; InfinityDS (Private): Internal engineering platform; Saba CMS (Private): Multi-tenant content platform; Saba CMS NG (Private): Next-generation content & commerce platform; Radiant (Private): Internal sales & pricing console; HOMA (Private): Engineering rule engine; TINV (Private): Regulatory e-invoicing & tax compliance platform

g.text: A Laravel-backed game platform with a deterministic fixed-update GameRuntime, Canvas2D nearest-neighbor renderer,
data-driven shared café, open-world chunks, role-play systems, events, Hide & Seek, and Tetris.
A modern Laravel 13 music application structured around albums, artists, playlists, songs, and a home experience, with a
Configuration, calculation, visualization, pricing, and export tooling for modular lighting design. A Laravel application that
turns design inputs into structured configurations and tracked results.
A modular CMS evolving toward a Blade-first, tenant-safe architecture, with tenant-aware content, themes, media,
permissions, queues, search, caching, and modular business areas.
A ground-up Laravel 13 rewrite unifying content management and e-commerce behind one Admin + API surface, built as
an incremental successor track rather than a big-bang rewrite.
A Persian RTL admin panel for step-based sales configuration, pricing, and Excel-driven reporting.
Lighting design calculations, panel selection, cable sizing, zone layout, and engineering output, with a target
modular-monolith architecture defined from the reverse-engineered rules.
Invoice lifecycle, digital signing, and ERP bridging for statutory tax-invoice compliance.
